summary: Two churches (St. Luke, Stratford; St. Lawrence/Guadalupe Shrine, Lindenwold) plus Our Lady of Grace Chapel, which is not on the church list. Both bulletins read (Nov 8, Nov 15) print the same schedule box, matching the website; Thanksgiving evening Mass and Adoration are cancelled. Open: one grouped question on whether the chapel (Mon/Wed bilingual Mass, first-Friday Mass, confessions, Wed/Thu Adoration, Monday Holy Hour) is on the St. Lawrence grounds.

slots.rationale: R32: the chapel is not on the church list. Bulletins place it in Lindenwold ('Our Lady of Grace Chapel, Lindenwold, NJ', p4/p5), where St. Lawrence is the parish's only church, and say to enter it through the old Spanish Office; the website gives no address for it, and its sacraments page names a former 'Our Lady of Grace' church (whose records moved to this parish), so it might be a separate building. Leaning St. Lawrence because every source puts it in Lindenwold beside the shrine's offices; if it is elsewhere it becomes a church-list issue (R23).
slots.question: Our Lady of Grace Chapel is in Lindenwold, entered through the old Spanish Office; is it on the St. Lawrence grounds (135 N. White Horse Pike)?
